summary: No. Pooled across BTC, ETH and SOL, no Awesome Oscillator setting beat random entries on 1h, 4h or daily. The one result that holds up is narrow. On 1h, while the pair was above its 200-day SMA, price did 0.23% worse than random 20 candles after AO crossed down through 0. That holds without its strongest stretch and at 10 candles, but it is gone at 50 and 100.

notes: AO crossing up through 0 on 1h gave 3,606 entries in 2,747 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.01% ahead of random entries, inside the luck band of -0.14% to 0.1%. On 4h the same cross lands at -0.01%, and on daily at -0.45%. The cross down through 0 shows the same nothing when the trends are pooled.

Split by trend, the 1h cross down through 0 comes apart. While the pair closed above its 200-day SMA, price did 0.23% worse than after random uptrend candles 20 candles later. The luck band tops out at 0.12%. The result holds without its strongest stretch and at 10 candles, but fades at 50 and 100. In downtrends it showed nothing.

Holding a long while AO was above 0 on 4h beat random by 0.25%. Holding a short while it was below 0 beat random by 0.27%. Both come from SOL, and BTC and ETH stayed inside the band. The long vanishes without the run between Jul 21 and Sep 12, 2021. The short vanishes without the drop between Apr 6 and Jun 20, 2022, which spans the Terra collapse.

On daily, the uptrend side of AO below 0 is the clearest short result. While the pair was above its 200-day SMA, price did 6.55% worse than random uptrend days 20 days after AO sat below 0. It holds without its strongest stretch and at 10 days, but rests on only 41 separate moves. In downtrends it showed nothing, so the pooled daily result reads as chance.

AO crossing up its 5-bar SMA while below 0 showed nothing pooled on any timeframe. On daily in uptrends, price did 7.58% worse than random 20 days later. That holds without its strongest stretch and at 10 days. In downtrends the same signal beat random by 2.94%, but only because of signals between Jun 17 and Jun 29, 2023.

For a long DCA bot, the zero-line cross and the turn below 0 add no timing on these pairs, so the take profit and DCA orders do the work. AO's information sits on the short side in uptrends: after the 1h cross down through 0, and while daily AO sat below 0. That shape showed at 10 and 20 candles and was gone by 50. So it fits beside other conditions with a take profit sized to fill early. The daily turn below 0 is a reason to leave that condition out of a long bot that trades in uptrends.
